column1: # Module 02 — tutor setup. Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
Illusion of knowing: feeling you could do {{c1::what you only watched}}.
Best-evidenced study technique: {{c1::active recall}} — answering from memory.
Spaced repetition: review {{c1::just before you'd forget}}, at {{c2::stretching intervals}}.
FSRS {{c1::learns YOUR forgetting curve and schedules each card}}.
Anki numbers: retention {{c1::0.90}} · {{c2::10}} new/day · backlog cap {{c3::20 reviews + bulk-suspend}}.
Anki pipeline (law amended 26/08/2026): {{c1::sessions draft AND import; Samrath reviews and vetoes}}.
Wall rule: {{c1::30+ min genuine struggle}} before any hint.
The dojo: {{c1::20 daily minutes hunting planted bugs}}.
Dojo level-up: {{c1::three clean days}} → up; brutal day = {{c2::stay, never drop}}.
L0 bug classes: {{c1::swallowed error branches}} · {{c2::unverified side-effects before destructive ops}} · {{c3::wrong filter predicate}}.
Broken-streak restart: {{c1::ONE 20-minute dojo}}; never {{c2::two zero-days in a row}}.
Journal tracks numbers because {{c1::feelings don't grade — data answers panic}}.
Weekly outage test: {{c1::"If Anthropic went down a week, what % of my productivity survives?"}} — must trend up.
Claude banned during: {{c1::struggle reps}} · {{c2::20% AI-free quota}} · {{c3::first 30 min of a wall}}.
Tutor contract rule 1: {{c1::never show a full solution}} — concepts + a different example.
20 min/day beats 2h/week because {{c1::spacing applies to skills}}.
